paper.title_en: Cauchy-horizon flux coefficients in the reduced Polyakov model
paper.abstract_en: We study Cauchy-horizon flux amplification in the stationary reduced Polyakov model for spherically symmetric charged black holes. The corresponding four-dimensional coefficient depends on global scattering and on the quantum state, while the reduced model gives an exactly calculable anomaly-induced radial contribution. For a nonextremal inner horizon on a stationary background, a finite late-time Eddington--Finkelstein flux is amplified by the affine blueshift into a leading $V_-^{-2}$ divergence. In the Polyakov model the coefficient is $F_-^{(\infty)}=t_v-Nκ_-^2/(48π)$, so the leading term vanishes only when $t_v=Nκ_-^2/(48π)$. This inner-horizon condition is distinct from the corresponding outer-horizon condition on $t_u$, while standard Unruh-type and outer-horizon thermal choices generically lie away from it. Other quantum contributions and classical tails enter through the total late-time flux. Cancellation of the $V_-^{-2}$ term requires the total constant coefficient $F_0$ to vanish, while asymptotically flat power-law tails produce logarithmically weakened divergences and exponentially decaying de~Sitter tails produce a different power of $V_-$. These results identify the conditions controlling the leading Cauchy-horizon divergence and its cancellation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在球对称带电黑洞的约化Polyakov模型中系统分析Cauchy视界通量放大，明确给出异常诱导系数的解析形式F_-^{(∞)}=t_v-Nκ_-²/(48π)，并讨论了内视界抵消条件与Unruh型、外视界热态选择的区别，还分析了平直幂律尾与de Sitter指数尾对发散结构的影响。理论推导具体、条件陈述清晰，属于广义相对论基础与黑洞物理交叉的可读性较高的理论工作。
decision.title_zh: 约化Polyakov模型中的Cauchy视界通量系数
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了球对称带电黑洞的稳态约化Polyakov模型中的Cauchy视界通量放大。相应的四维系数依赖于全局散射和量子态，而约化模型给出一个可精确计算的异常诱导径向贡献。对于稳态背景上的非极端内视界，有限的晚期Eddington--Finkelstein通量被仿射蓝移放大为主导的$V_-^{-2}$发散。在Polyakov模型中，系数为$F_-^{(\infty)}=t_v-Nκ_-^2/(48π)$，因此当且仅当$t_v=Nκ_-^2/(48π)$时主导项消失。这个内视界条件不同于关于$t_u$的相应外视界条件，而标准的Unruh型和外视界热选择一般远离该条件。其他量子贡献和经典尾通过总晚期通量进入。$V_-^{-2}$项的抵消要求总常数系数$F_0$为零，而渐近平坦的幂律尾产生对数减弱的发散，指数衰减的de~Sitter尾产生$V_-$的不同幂次。这些结果确定了控制主导Cauchy视界发散及其抵消的条件。
